title: Dialogue cleanup: hum, hiss and clicks out
caption: A noisy dialogue take played twice: first raw, with mains hum, hiss and clicks, then after the cleanup chain (declick, rumble-reduction EQ, noise gate, compressor). The two waveforms show the noise floor between phrases disappear while the voice stays.
prompt: Generate 6 seconds of synthetic noisy dialogue (make-audio.mjs: a voice-like tone track, no real speech, with 50 Hz mains hum and its harmonics, hiss and random clicks). Clean it up with the audio skill: remove the clicks first, then cut the hum with the rumble-reduction EQ, gate the hiss in the pauses (threshold -26 dB, ratio 8; after the EQ so the hum cannot hold the gate open) and level it with the broadcast-master compressor. Make a 12-second before/after clip on the Magnifito cream background (panels.svg, Geist from fonts/): the raw take plays first under its waveform, then the clean take under its waveform, with a playhead and the active panel highlighted.
commands: ffmpeg -loop 1 -framerate 30 -t 12 -i work/panels.png -i work/wave-before.png -i work/wave-after.png -i work/noisy.wav -i work/clean.wav -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=160:210[v1];[v1][2:v]overlay=160:660,drawbox=x=140:y=640:w=1640:h=320:color=0xf0eadf@0.6:t=fill:enable='lt(t,6)',drawbox=x=140:y=190:w=1640:h=320:color=0xf0eadf@0.6:t=fill:enable='gte(t,6)',drawbox=x=140:y=190:w=10:h=320:color=0x8acf31:t=fill:enable='lt(t,6)',drawbox=x=140:y=640:w=10:h=320:color=0x8acf31:t=fill:enable='gte(t,6)'[bg];color=c=0x2b1c17:s=4x300:r=30:d=12,split[p1][p2];[bg][p1]overlay=x='160+1600*t/6':y=200:enable='lt(t,6)'[bg2];[bg2][p2]overlay=x='160+1600*(t-6)/6':y=650:enable='gte(t,6)',format=yuv420p[v];[3:a][4:a]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1,aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo[a]" -map [v] -map [a] -t 12 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/compare.mp4
